rca_of_issue: User complaint chain: (1) lock_score drift for elite scorers (Vinicius/Salah/Mbappé/Haaland showing 55-65). Root cause: 30+ writers across evidence_engine, validator, learning_v2, govern_pick, lazy governance, bandit, player_form mutate lock_score independently — any of them can transiently demote v1 while v2/raw/peak hold the true anchors. Fix: read-time canonicalize-max in server.py:_canonicalize_lock_score takes max(v1,v2,raw,peak) and clamps to 99, plus an elite_player belt-and-suspenders 95 floor. VERIFIED — zero elites below 95 in the slate. (2) FilterSheet wiped market on Apply. Root cause: previous version of apply() built a fresh object only from sheet-owned knobs (minLock/minImplied/maxImplied/simEdgeFloor), dropping market/league/event. Fix (FilterSheet.tsx L78-97): spread ...filters first, then override the sheet-owned knobs. VERIFIED working on a fresh bundle. Initial Playwright run failed because the served bundle was stale; after restarting Expo the new bundle deployed and the test passed.
